releaseNote: Badges mark what ships in DnsClientX 2.1.2 on NuGet and the PowerShell Gallery. Items marked Next release are merged in source and arrive with the next public version.

transports.name: UDP
transports.detail: Classic DNS with automatic TCP fallback on truncation and socket reuse.

transports.name: TCP
transports.detail: Persistent, pipelined sessions for large answers and zone work.

transports.name: DNS over TLS
transports.detail: RFC 7858 with pooled sessions, dot ALPN and strict certificate checks.

transports.name: DNS over HTTPS
transports.detail: RFC 8484 wire format over GET or POST, plus the JSON APIs, on HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2.

transports.name: DNS over HTTP/3
transports.detail: DoH3 in the core package on .NET 8 and .NET 10, no extra dependencies.

transports.name: DNS over QUIC
transports.detail: RFC 9250 pooled DoQ where the runtime exposes QUIC.

transports.name: DNS over gRPC
transports.detail: Wire-format DNS over gRPC for resolvers that publish it, with runtime capability checks.

transports.name: Multicast DNS
transports.detail: mDNS queries and continuous DNS-SD browsing across IPv4 and IPv6 interfaces.

transports.name: DNS stamps
transports.detail: sdns:// stamps for plain DNS, DoH, DoT and DoQ from one shared parser.

transports.name: Oblivious DoH
transports.detail: RFC 9230 through a separate relay so no single party sees who asked what.

transports.name: DNSCrypt v2
transports.detail: Authenticated, encrypted UDP/TCP and Anonymized DNSCrypt relays.

capabilities.title: Typed records
capabilities.body: Ask for raw strings or parsed objects: MX priorities, SOA timers, TXT fragments, TLSA, SVCB and more, with owner, class, remaining TTL and the original wire evidence kept.
capabilities.code:
var response = await ClientX.QueryDns("evotec.pl", DnsRecordType.MX,
    DnsEndpoint.Cloudflare, typedRecords: true);

capabilities.title: DNSSEC you can trust
capabilities.body: Local chain validation to the IANA root with Secure, Insecure, Bogus and Indeterminate results, authenticated denial, iterative root resolution, QNAME minimisation and RFC 5011 anchor rollover.

capabilities.title: Many resolvers, one answer
capabilities.body: FirstSuccess, FastestWins, SequentialFallback and RoundRobin strategies with global and per-endpoint concurrency caps, single-flight caching and order-preserving batches.

capabilities.title: Measure resolvers
capabilities.body: Probe, benchmark and score resolver catalogs, save the results and let DnsClientX pick the best endpoint for the network you are on.

capabilities.title: Zones and updates
capabilities.body: AXFR and IXFR, XFR-over-TLS, ZONEMD digests, TSIG authentication, a BIND master-file parser and atomic RFC 2136 UPDATE batches with prerequisites.

capabilities.title: Service discovery
capabilities.body: RFC 6763 DNS-SD over unicast and multicast, continuous mDNS browsing with goodbyes and expiry, and DDR discovery of a resolver's verified encrypted endpoints.

capabilities.title: Your system resolver
capabilities.body: Reads the operating system's resolvers without silent public fallback: Windows NRPT routing, resolv.conf search lists and ndots, EDNS client subnet and source binding.
capabilities.code: var response = await ClientX.QueryDns("intranet.contoso", DnsRecordType.A, DnsEndpoint.System);

capabilities.title: Works in the browser
capabilities.body: A caller-owned HttpClient DNS JSON client runs in Blazor WebAssembly. Every DomainDetective browser tool resolves through it.
capabilities.code:
var response = await DnsJsonQueryClient.QueryAsync(httpClient,
    new Uri("https://dns.google/resolve"), "evotec.pl", DnsRecordType.A);
